images.seen: No gross error at world scale; Zambia and Zimbabwe still Company land, Greenland and the Sahara grey by design, Kazakh SSR and RSFSR share one dark red.
Matches the pages: Polish-Soviet front contested, Belarus SSR holds Minsk, Greek occupation hatched in Anatolia, Allied zone grey at Istanbul; only differences from Cliopatria are deliberate.

Bogd Khanate, Tuva, Far Eastern Republic, Priamurye enclave and warlord blocks look right; grey hole in the Khabarovsk krai (3,138 cells, 1921 only); Anhui clique reduced to Shandong and the east coast.
Hejaz taken by the Third Saudi State, Iraq drawn as two hatched halves (north British Colonial Empire occupied by Iraq, south Iraq occupied by Britain), Oman, Aden, Imamate right.
Zhili, Fengtian, Guominjun, Shanxi and Kuomintang blocks plausible and far richer than Cliopatria; no stray cells.
Wrong: Zambia and Zimbabwe grey (nobody) since the Company's loss events name no dossier, and British Africa drawn over the whole Kufra district of Libya.
Rhodesia filled as British Africa, Kufra now Senussi land (hatched, contested with Italy); about 550 Libyan cells (Ajdabiya, Butnan, Murzuq) still British, left.
No gross error; Ukraine, Belarus, Transcaucasia and Russia proper all plain Soviet Union while Kazakh, Uzbek and Turkmen show as half-tint constituents (see issue on the founding event).
Shows that the founding republics stay swallowed after 1929: Ukrainian SSR has 36 cells and Belarus 94; Soviet Union is one block.

issues.what: Southern Rhodesia (1,304 cells, 1923-1925) and Northern Rhodesia (2,495 cells, 1924-1925) are nobody's land: the Company's loss events name counterparts with no dossier; British Africa's 1926 keyframe then snaps +3,775 cells.

British Africa holds 1,940 Libyan cells from the start anchor, among them the whole Kufra district (1,389), which was Senussi land until the Italians seized it in 1931; R1 (colony) beats the Senussi keyframes.
About 550 further Libyan cells (Ajdabiya 251, Murzuq 159, Al Butnan 23, Al Jufrah 12) stay British Africa; the Senussi keyframes claim most of them, but the page opened does not place them.
Smyrna enclave: Cliopatria's 1922 Greek shape keeps 14 cells round Izmir; the 1924 shape has none but the snap threshold (20 cells) never removed them, so Greece held Smyrna through 1930.
The Smyrna enclave is nobody's (neutral) at the end of 1922 only: the Ottoman dissolve region (Cliopatria's 1922 shape) leaves it out and the Republic of Turkey starts in 1923.

Vilnius: Cliopatria's 1924 Lithuanian shape holds the city and the 1924 Polish shape does not, so the snaps handed Vilnius to Lithuania from 1924 although the ledger has Poland annexing it in 1922 and Lithuania regaining it in 1939.

The Union's founding event (USSR ledger 0, 30 Dec 1922) takes the land of the four founding republics: the Ukrainian SSR keeps 36 cells, the Byelorussian SSR 94, the Transcaucasian SFSR 42, the RSFSR 851 (of 41,040), and the Armenian and Azerbaijani SSRs 6 and 5; all become plain 'Soviet Union' although the page calls the USSR a federation of union republics and hierarchy.csv makes them constituents. A patch would move more than 40,000 cells and break every later event that moves USSR land (1939, 1941-45).

Iraq mandate is drawn as two mirror occupations: 1,046 northern cells (Mosul, from Cliopatria's British shape) stay British Colonial Empire land occupied by the Kingdom of Iraq, 593 southern cells are Iraq's land occupied by Britain; the British row has no matching end.

Khabarovsk krai and the Jewish Oblast (3,138 + 157 cells) are nobody's land for 1921 only, from a bridging loss to 'nobody' in the Far Eastern Republic ledger (event 9); Priamurye held Khabarovsk town.

The 1921 keyframes move Gansu, Shaanxi and Hunan (3,554 cells) from the Anhui clique to the Republic of China; the page gives only governors' tenures (Gansu and Hunan to 1920, Shaanxi to 1921), no dated loss, and the draw agrees with them to within a year.
The Nationalist government is 'kuomintang' in 1926-1928 (Hubei, Jiangsu, Xinjiang, Sichuan) and 'republic-of-china' on the same land in 1929; same colour, so only labels, captions and conflicts flip.
Portuguese colonies (Angola, Mozambique, Timor, India) have no metropole in 1926 (colonies.csv starts estado-novo in 1927, portuguese-republic rows end 1926).

Kazakh SSR: 2,308 cells (Syr Darya, Semirechye) show as plain USSR in 1922-1924, then snap to the Kazakh SSR in 1925; South Kazakhstan 68 and Kyrgyz 43 cells are nobody's in 1924; same colour, so nearly invisible.

Size-rule conflicts checked: Kumul/Kuomintang, Finland/RSFSR (Petsamo), Belgian Congo and Angola borders, Armenia/Georgia 1921, Fengtian/USSR, Moldavian ASSR, Chile/Peru (Arica Chilean; Tacna 24 cells Chilean until 1929, Peru 55 in 1929), Mongolia/RSFSR: the smaller state won rightly or the cells are cell-level edge noise.

dossier_requests.what: ledger 0 (found, 12/1922): exclude the land of the RSFSR, Ukrainian, Byelorussian and Transcaucasian republics (or give each a gain from the Union in 12/1922 and let a ruling keep the constituents), so the hierarchy.csv constituents hold their own land; the Union then draws only what no republic holds.
dossier_requests.why: The page: 'the USSR was a federation of constituent Union Republics' and the four founding republics 'kept their status'; the draft leaves them 36 to 851 cells and draws Ukraine, Belarus, Transcaucasia and Russia as one block until 1991. Not patched: moving more than 40,000 cells in my window changes what every later USSR loss and gain event (1939-45) finds.

dossier_requests.what: ledger 135 (occupation_start kingdom-of-iraq over all Iraq, 8/1921): give the 1,046 northern Iraq cells to kingdom-of-iraq at its founding (loss) and keep one occupation pair kingdom-of-iraq / kingdom-of-great-britain, ended 3 Oct 1932; the British row has no occupation_end.
dossier_requests.why: Kingdom of Iraq 'founded on 23 August 1921' and 'remained under de facto British administration until 1932'; the draft shows Mosul as British land occupied by Iraq for 1921-1932.

dossier_requests.what: ledger 238 (dissolve, 11/1922): region should be Cliopatria's 1922 Ottoman shape plus the Smyrna enclave (Izmir, 14 cells), which Turkey retook on 9 September 1922; today they are nobody's at the end of 1922.
dossier_requests.why: 'The Turkish cavalry rode into the town around eleven o'clock on the Saturday morning of 9 September'; the enclave is not in Cliopatria's 1922 Ottoman shape.

dossier_requests.what: Fold the Nationalist government of 1928-1929 into republic-of-china (or end kuomintang's land in 1928): Xinjiang, Sichuan, Hubei and Guangdong change label between 1928 and 1929 with no change of ruler.
dossier_requests.why: The Nanjing government 'disavowed continuity' with the Beiyang government 'though the state remained the Republic of China'.

problems: hierarchy: data/colonies.csv rows 281, 285, 291, 294 (portuguese-angola, portuguese-india, portuguese-mozambique, portuguese-timor with metropole estado-novo from 1927) start a year late: estado-novo is founded 28 May 1926 (its ledger 0, the portuguese-republic dissolves that month), so the four colonies stand alone at the end of 1926 (rows 280, 284, 290, 293 end 1926, a year late too). Start the estado-novo rows in 1926 and end the portuguese-republic rows in 1925. Page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portuguese_First_Republic (the First Republic ended with the 28 May 1926 coup; a military dictatorship followed).

Boundary: rulings/0 runs 1920..1930, one year past the window, so that the british-africa keyframe of 1930 does not take Kufra back from the Senussi (the Senussi 1931 keyframe drops Kufra and the ledger gives it to Italy in 1931). Window p1930-p1939 must keep Kufra away from british-africa's keyframes of 1932, 1936, 1940 (a ruling against italian-libya) or they snap it back.

Boundary: the Vilnius overrides (second-polish-republic_1924, kingdom-of-lithuania_1924) hold until the 1936 keyframes, which are 'ok' and still draw Vilnius as Lithuanian (the city cell is in Cliopatria's 1936 Lithuanian shape): p1930-p1939 needs the same override for the 1936 shapes, Poland keeping Vilnius until October 1939.

The end anchor p1930 changes 1,849 cells against the published draft (Kufra 1,389 to the Senussi; Vilnius, Smyrna and edge cells; the rest dossier edits made since 1 Nov), so the next window's start moves with it.

Rhodesia events: the 28 Mozambique-border cells (22 Zimbabwe, 6 Zambia) are British Africa's in 1924-1925 (R1 over Portugal) and Portuguese from 1926; before the patch they were Portuguese from 1924. About 55 British Africa cells outside its 1926 keyframe in Zambia and Manicaland go to nobody in 1926 as they already did.
Left unpatched, no page: Imbros (1 Greek cell in Canakkale to 1930s; the Lausanne page was not opened), Burgenland drawn Austrian at end 1920 (handover was 1921).
Page budget: 13 of 15 used; one (Central Lithuania) was a disambiguation page and was repeated on Republic of Central Lithuania.
